delete.description: Archives the institution: it leaves pickers and stays on the accounts that use it.

get.description: The user's accounts by name, each with its balance, the total balance of each institution in each currency, and the totals of each institution and of everything in the user's base currency, at today's exchange rates. A balance with no rate to convert it is left out of those and listed as not converted. The totals cover the whole list, whichever page is asked for. Archived accounts, which pickers never offer, only with includeArchived=true.

post.description: Adds an account. A credit card or loan sends amountOwed, a positive number, and shows a negative balance; any other type sends openingBalance. Any account can be labelled with the last 4 digits of its number, never more of it. Only a credit card takes creditLimit, statementDay and paymentDueDay.

get.description: One account, archived or not, with its balance. The ETag header carries its row version.

put.description: Changes an account; its balance follows a new opening balance at once, and a credit card's available credit a new credit limit. Every field is replaced: last4 or a credit card field left out is removed. Send the row version last read as If-Match: a stale one answers 412, none answers 428.

delete.description: Archives the account, at any balance: it leaves lists and pickers and stays in history.

get.description: The user's categories as a tree: top-level categories, each with its subcategories. Archived ones, which pickers never offer, only with includeArchived=true.

post.description: Adds a top-level category, or a subcategory when parentId is set. A subcategory has its parent's kind; categories are at most two levels deep.

put.description: Renames, recolours or re-icons a category, or changes a top-level category's kind together with its subcategories. The kind cannot change once any of them has transactions.

delete.description: Archives the category and its subcategories: they leave pickers and stay on the transactions that use them.

get.description: The user's transactions, newest date first and, within a date, last recorded first. A deleted transaction is never listed.

post.description: Records income or an expense on an account, in the account's currency; the account's balance follows at once. An expense flagged isRefund is a refund and raises the balance. Send lines in place of categoryId to split it across categories: lines that do not sum exactly to the amount are refused. Send an Idempotency-Key the client made up for this transaction: a retry with the same key answers the transaction the first request recorded and records nothing, and a different transaction sent with a key already used answers 422.

get.description: One transaction. The ETag header carries its row version. A deleted transaction is not found.

put.description: Changes a transaction; the balance of its account, and of the account it was moved from, follows at once. Send the row version last read as If-Match: a stale one answers 412, none answers 428.

delete.description: Deletes the transaction: it leaves lists and its account's balance at once.

get.description: The user's recurring rules, the last set up first.

post.description: Sets up income or an expense that repeats. The worker posts each occurrence as a transaction on its due date, in the user's time zone. A start date in the past is allowed: the occurrences since then are posted, each on its own due date.

put.description: Replaces what the rule's next transactions say and when they are due. Transactions it already posted stay as they are, and a new schedule carries on after the last occurrence posted or skipped.

delete.description: Deletes the rule: it posts nothing more. The transactions it posted stay, no longer linked to a rule.

post.description: Pauses the rule: it posts nothing until it is resumed.
Resumes a paused rule: it posts again from today. The occurrences that were due while it was paused are skipped.
